cohort: Preterm neonates between 28 and 34 weeks of gestation admitted to a tertiary care hospital in western Nepal.
finding: The incidence of feeding intolerance was 11.02% in preterm neonates (28-34 weeks), with a higher proportion in very low birth weight babies.
followup_time: Until death or discharge from hospital (variable, but at least several days)
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of all enrolled babies was 1550g, and mean birth weight of babies with feeding intolerance was 1418g; 61.1% of babies with feeding intolerance were very low birth weight.
